findings.note: As of Nov 12, this RotoWire/CBS update had Coward averaging 2.3 made threes per game, which is above the 1.5 line; that came after he made 1 of 4 threes against Denver.

On Nov 14 he made 4 of 6 threes in 33 minutes while Ty Jerome (hip) and Zach Edey (ankle) were out. He is shooting 43.5% from three this season, up from 33.8% as a rookie, which suggests a bigger role, though that rate could fall back.

His last five games show 2, 4, 0, 1 and 1 made threes on 4 to 6 attempts each (Under 1.5 hit in 3 of 5), including 2 of 4 in 27 minutes at Washington on Nov 16. I found no injury report for Nov 18 or any analyst pick on this market.
